jess (support): FYI — escalation from AcmeCorp. They saw a sudden drop in generation quality after a regional failover. customer says outputs are garbled and some tokens look like raw token ids.

sam (oncall): can you paste the request id + sample?

jess (support): Request ID: req_0a9f6c2d. Customer region: eu-west-1. They hit a 503 in their region around 14:02 UTC and we fell back to us-east-1.

jess (support): Minimal repro (they shared):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" \\n  -d '{"model": "redwood-13b", "input": "Summarize: The quarterly results...", "max_tokens": 80}'
```

jess (support): Expected coherent summary. Actual (snippet from customer):
"Output: \u003c0x12 101 297 4002\u003e \u003c|endoftext|\u003e" — basically low-level tokens and weird separators.

mira (ml): that looks like a tokenizer/vocab mismatch — like the model served on failover is using a different tokenizer (or older vocab) than the original serving config.

chris (infra): logs: region failover triggered at 2026-03-16T14:02:31Z for pool eu-west-1. Routing policy matched fallback -> us-east-1:pool-b. Model substitution: redwood-13b -> redwood-13b-compat-legacy-2024-09.

sam (oncall): aha. compat-legacy variant has a legacy tokenizer adapter (BPEmap v1) while redwood-13b (hosted) uses BPE-v2. Shouldn't we only route to variants with compatible tokenizer profiles?

deploy-bot: deploy event: automatic fallback policy applied (policy_id: pf-84).

mira (ml): Our routing table contains tokenizer hashes to validate compatibility, but it looks like pool-b was missing the updated tokenizer hash after the sep-2024 model re-tokenization. Patch needed.

jess (support): Customer impact: several API calls returned garbled outputs, some downstream parsing code crashed because it expected text. They asked for immediate mitigation and a rollback path.

chris (infra): Immediate mitigation options:
- force route customer to us-west-2 region where the primary model is available (temp)
- pin model_version on the API side (model=redwood-13b@2026-02-10) to avoid variant substitution
- revert fallback policy to avoid pool-b until we sync tokenizer hashes

sam (oncall): for quick rollback I've changed the customer's account routing to prefer region eu-west-1:hosts only, and disabled that autopolicy for their tenant (done). Customer confirms requests now hit eu-west-1 primary.

jess (support): Customer confirms improved output now. Thanks Sam. They want root cause and a fix so this doesn't happen org-wide.

mira (ml): Root cause summary draft: after we re-tokenized redwood-13b in Sep 2024 (BPE-v2), we added tokenizer compatibility metadata (tokenizer_hash) to the model manifest. During an infra migration in Feb 2026 pool-b lost the updated manifest sync and still served a 2024 legacy-compatible build (with different tokenizer). When routing fallback happened, the policy matched compatible by architecture only (13B) but did not validate tokenizer_hash. Result: model served with incompatible vocab leading to garbled token streams.

chris (infra): Action items:
1) Emergency: ensure all pools advertise tokenizer_hash and update routing policy to require hash match (INF-1247) — hotfix deployed to routing layer at 14:25 UTC.
2) Audit: run model manifest diff across pools and surface any mismatches (INF-1248).
3) Long term: add pre-failover compatibility check that simulates token decode on a small prompt (safety probe) (ML-983).

mira (ml): I've started a small test harness that encodes a canonical probe and compares decoded string; will open PR for pre-failover probe.

sam (oncall): Logging/telemetry changes we need: log "served_model_variant" and "tokenizer_hash" in request traces and expose in console per-route. Filing support ticket template for customers to paste request id + served_model_variant so we can triage faster (SUP-2026).

jess (support): I'll send root cause + mitigation to customer and include steps to pin version if they prefer. Also ask them to share any failing request IDs.

chris (infra): Note: for any tenants we disabled autopolicy for, re-enable only after pool manifests are synced (will notify here).

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout complete: routing-layer v2.1.3 -> live (checks added).

mira (ml): follow-up: we'll add a nightly job to verify manifest parity across regions.

jess (support): Thanks everyone. I'll close the customer loop and mark this resolved for now. Will reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
